Tokiyo Lifestyle Partner Network – Partner Terms
Bhubaneswar → Odisha → Major Indian Cities → Pan-India
By joining the Tokiyo Lifestyle Partner Network, the business agrees to provide the benefit communicated and agreed upon with Tokiyo Lifestyle.
The ultimate vision is to build a network where Tokiyo Lifestyle customers receive exclusive benefits while partner businesses receive marketing and customer acquisition support.
In short, the strategy is built around three things:
Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the standard benefit offered to verified Tokiyo members will be 5% off on eligible purchases.
Partners must verify the customer's Tokiyo Membership through the approved Tokiyo verification method before applying the benefit.
Tokiyo Lifestyle Partner Benefits – Customer Terms
This approach can help Tokiyo Lifestyle create stronger brand awareness, build a loyal customer community, support local businesses, and differentiate itself from ordinary clothing brands.

The partner may define reasonable exclusions, such as selected products, services, special menus, ongoing promotions, or minimum purchase requirements. Such exclusions must be communicated clearly to Tokiyo and customers.
The Tokiyo partner benefits are available only to users with an active and valid Tokiyo Lifestyle membership.
Once a customer's membership is successfully verified, the agreed discount should be applied to the eligible transaction.
Partners must not impose an additional charge on customers specifically for claiming the Tokiyo benefit.
Customers must present their valid Tokiyo Membership ID, QR code, or other verification method provided by Tokiyo at the participating partner location.
Partners may be provided with Tokiyo promotional material, QR codes, stickers, or digital assets. Partners are encouraged to display them prominently at their premises.
The standard partner benefit is 5% off, unless a different offer is specifically mentioned on the Tokiyo website or by the respective partner.
Tokiyo Lifestyle may promote participating partners through its website, social media, advertising campaigns, influencer campaigns, and other marketing channels.
The partner business may verify the customer's membership before providing the applicable discount.
Partners agree to provide accurate information including business name, address, contact details, operating hours, discount terms, photographs, and social media links where required.
Unless otherwise stated by the partner, the discount is applicable only once per transaction and cannot be transferred to another person.
Partners must inform Tokiyo Lifestyle of significant changes to their business, including relocation, closure, change in operating hours, or changes to the agreed customer benefit.

Partners are responsible for maintaining the quality of their own products and services. Participation in the Tokiyo network does not transfer responsibility for the partner's operations to Tokiyo Lifestyle.
The Tokiyo benefit cannot be combined with other discounts, promotional offers, coupons, or special pricing unless the partner specifically permits it.
Either Tokiyo Lifestyle or the partner may terminate the partnership subject to the agreed notice period, if any.
A Tokiyo membership is personal to the registered customer and must not be shared, sold, or transferred.

Tokiyo Lifestyle may remove a partner from its network if the partner repeatedly fails to honour the agreed benefit, provides misleading information, engages in fraudulent activity, or violates the partnership terms.
The discount is available only at participating Tokiyo partner businesses listed on the official Tokiyo platform.

Each partner operates independently. Participation in the Tokiyo Partner Network does not create a franchise, agency, employment, joint venture, or ownership relationship between Tokiyo Lifestyle and the partner.
Individual partners may have reasonable additional conditions, exclusions, or minimum purchase requirements. These conditions will be communicated wherever applicable.
Tokiyo Lifestyle may update the Partner Network terms from time to time. Partners will be notified of material changes where appropriate.
Tokiyo Lifestyle reserves the right to suspend or terminate membership where fraudulent activity, misuse, manipulation, or unauthorized sharing of membership credentials is identified.
Tokiyo Lifestyle may add, remove, modify, or discontinue partner benefits without prior notice.

Tokiyo Lifestyle does not control the products, services, pricing, quality, availability, or customer service provided by independent partner businesses. Any service-related issue should be addressed directly with the respective partner.
